source_review_notes: The primary paper reports OD600 growth-curve activity, not MIC/MBC/IC50/hemolysis/cytotoxicity tables.
P3, P10, and P26 sequences and prediction scores were reconciled from Table 5.
Figure 3 and the results text support two strong P3 antibacterial effects, two P10/P26 subtle E. coli slowing effects, and the reported no-effect outcomes against the other bacteria.
No exact numeric OD600 point table or dose-response table was found in XML, PDF text, OA package, mmc1/mmc2 supplemental PDFs, or packet database rows.
